parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

The parameter value consists of ASCII characters with a maximum length of 64 characters. Non-ASCII characters are not allowed.

parameters.name: DBInstanceEndpointDescription
parameters.description: The custom description of the endpoint.

parameters.name: DBInstanceEndpointId
parameters.description: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints to query the endpoint ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: NodeItems
parameters.description: The information list of endpoint nodes.

sub_parameters.name: DBInstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.

sub_parameters.name: NodeId
sub_parameters.description:
The node ID.

You can query the node ID by using the following methods:
- View the node ID in the instance topology diagram at the bottom of the instance details page in the ApsaraDB RDS console.
- Call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to query the node ID.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The current weight value of the node. Read traffic is distributed based on this value.

Valid values: 0 to 100.
